source_summary: kyocera-sgstool.com product data (the site's BigCommerce catalog API behind each product page: EDP, DC/APMX/LF/DCON/RE, flutes, helix, coating, series) for the High Performance Aluminum (S-Carb 43/47, Ski-Carb 44/45, APR/APR-3 roughers), General Application 2/3 flute (series 3, 5, 17, 52, 59, 24 tapered ball), Micro 2/3 flute (>= 0.020 in) end mills and the wood / composite routers (21, 22, 20, 25, 31); speed & feed charts from the SGS Global Catalog v26.1. 4+ flute, steel/HTA, form and left-hand tools left out.
